Ray Casting in Direct Volume Rendering - Scribd
Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) uses ray-casting to render 3D volumetric data without converting it to surface geometry. Ray-casting works by (1) tracing a ray from each pixel into the volume, (2) computing color values by sampling along the ray, and (3) assigning the final color value to the pixel.
